summary: Design confirmed. PLAN.md is written from the answers — 10 normative contract blocks in §1, 18 steps across 6 phases, each with a self-checking gate. One review left before implementation: §1 is what an executor actually obeys, so it needs your eyes the way the charts did. Look hardest at §0, which records that Q96 supersedes Q20 and Q93 supersedes Q23, and flags one interpretation I had to make where Q83 and Q55 meet.
